runs.cause: Required checkpoint and backup CLI arguments were omitted; runner exited with usage error.
runs.correction: Repeated with explicit workspace, checkpoint and backup paths.

runs.cause: Wrong flag --expect-backend=failed selected live mode and produced 8/17.
New class cache had not yet been imported by Godot, producing a parse/class-resolution failure.
runs.correction: Performed an isolated Editor import, then reran the full gate.

runs.cause: The first deterministic out-of-range test setup selected a route that did not converge in the fresh runtime; 65/75 completed.
runs.correction: Made the test-only setup try bounded nav-valid directions and accept only authority/presentation-converged placement.

runs.cause: Six unnecessary-await GDScript warnings made the Editor debugger non-clean.
runs.correction: Removed non-coroutine awaits and added a real Timer-based success linger for Editor evidence capture.

runs.cause: After warning removal the gate exited before the bridge could capture complete output.
runs.correction: Kept headless linger at zero while Editor Bridge defaults to an 8-second real Timer linger.

runs.cause: 67/73: newly authority-projected actor colliders occupied routes that the historical B2 harness assumed were empty.
runs.correction: Adjusted only the Stage17 B2 harness to choose deterministic nav-valid paths with presentation clearance from active actor bindings.

runs.cause: Historical harness moved target Nodes as if their transforms were spatial authority, then additional retries encountered consumed/stale targets and an insufficient Ground Loot approach step (88/91 and 86/91 among the discarded runs).
runs.correction: Migrated the harness to real Player MOVE_TO_POINT, discovered the actual front-most live target, used isolated runtime state, and used the existing explicit-destination movement budget for the post-defeat approach.

runs.cause: The prior combat run had consumed the encounter target; G19 stopped after 29/32 early checks.
runs.correction: Archived the contaminated Stage17 runtime state without deleting it, booted a fresh isolated Stage17 world, and repeated G19.
